verses.text: Ayik ayoch winhaj Artajerjes reyal t'a Persia, ay jun winh skuchan Esdras. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham winh, haton tik: Winhaj Seraías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Salum, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Finees, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Aarón winh b'ab'el sacerdote.

Ha winhaj Esdras chi', k'ayb'um winh t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová sDiosal Israel, haton k'ayb'ub'al yak'nak Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés. Masanil tas ix sk'an winh, ix yak' winhaj rey Artajerjes chi' t'a winh, yujto a Jehová ayoch yet' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix paxta winh t'a Babilonia.

Ayik yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Artajerjes chi' reyal, ix jawi winhaj Esdras chi' t'a Jerusalén tik yet' jun nhilanh heb' yetisraelal, haton heb' sacerdote, heb' levita sb'itani yet' heb' stanhwan puerta yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo.

Ayoch Dios yet' winhaj Esdras chi', yuj chi' ix kot winh t'a Babilonia t'a b'ab'el k'u yik b'ab'el uj, t'a yukil ab'il yoch winhaj Artajerjes chi' reyal. Ix jawi winh yet' heb' ajun yet'ok t'a Jerusalén tik t'a b'ab'el k'u yik yo'il uj, hanheja' t'a yukil ab'il chi'.
Te ayoch t'a spensar winhaj Esdras chi' sk'ayb'an wal sk'ayb'ub'al Dios, sb'eyb'alan winh yet' sk'ayb'anpax heb' yetisraelal winh t'a jun k'ayb'ub'al chi'.
Haton scopia'il scheknab'il winhaj rey Artajerjes tik ix yak' t'a winhaj sacerdote Esdras, k'ayb'um t'a sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová yet' scheknab'il ak'b'il t'a heb' yetisraelal:
Ha in Artajerjes in, yajal waj t'a juntzanhxo heb' rey, swak' stzatzil a k'o'ol ach Esdras, sacerdote ach, k'ayb'um ach pax t'a sk'ayb'ub'al sDiosal satcha'anh.
Toxo ix walel t'a masanil heb' etisraelal, heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita ayek' t'a yol in makb'en tik, tato syal sk'ol heb' sb'at t'a Jerusalén chi' het'ok, b'atokab' heb'.
Ha in tik yet' ukwanh heb' tz'ak'an in razón, tzach kak'b'at ila' tas wal yaj Judá yet' Jerusalén chi', wan am sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il he Diosal ayek' t'a yol a k'ab' chi' heb'.
Ha k'e'en plata yet' k'e'en oro tz'el t'a ko k'o'ol kak'anb'at t'ayach, ik'b'at k'e'en t'a he Diosal a ex israel ex chi', haton jun ay skajnub' t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Tzik'anpaxb'at masanil k'e'en plata, k'e'en oro ix a cha t'a heb' anima t'a yol yik Babilonia yet' jantak tas tz'el t'a sk'ol heb' etisraelal yet' heb' sacerdote yak'an yuj skajnub' he Diosal chi'.

Ha yet' k'e'en tumin chi' tza man nok' wakax, nok' ch'ak kalnel, nok' yunetak kalnel yet' juntzanhxo tastak tz'ak'ji yet' nok', haton ixim trigo, ixim cebada, wino yik tz'ak'ji juntzanh chi' silab'il t'a yib'anh altar t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi'.
Haxo jantakto k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata skani, ol xo heyila' tas b'aj wach' syal yoch k'e'en, icha syal tas snib'ej he Diosal chi'.
Haxo pax masanil yamk'ab' ix ak'ji t'ayach yik sk'anchaji yik tz'och ejmelal t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi', a ach wal lak'an tzak' t'a a Diosal t'a Jerusalén chi'.
Yalnhej junokxo tas ay tz'och eyu'uj t'a skajnub' he Diosal chi', syal he k'ananelta stojol t'a winh smolan k'e'en tumin t'a yol in makb'en.

Ha in rey Artajerjes in tik swal t'a masanil heb' molum tumin t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates: Masanil tas sk'an winhaj Esdras winh sacerdote, winh k'ayb'um pax t'a sk'ayb'ub'al sDiosal satcha'anh, elanhchamel tzeyak' t'a winh.
Syal eyak'an 75 quintalok k'e'en plata, 300 quintalok ixim trigo, 550 galónok wino, 550 galónok aceite yet' jantak atz'am atz'am sk'an winh.
Masanil tas sk'an sDiosal satcha'anh yuj skajnub', elanhchamelokab' tz'ak'chaji, yik wach' max kot yowal sk'ol t'a wib'anh yet' t'a yib'anh heb' wal wuninal yet' t'a yib'anh masanil in makb'en.

Tzeyojtakaneli to max yal-laj he k'anan k'e'en tumin t'a heb' sacerdote, t'a heb' levita sb'itani yet' t'a heb' tanhwum puerta yet' t'a heb' smunlaj t'a stemplo Dios chi', haton k'e'en syak' heb' t'ayin, ma juntzanhxo k'e'en mol tumin.

Ha hachxo pax tik ach Esdras, hato ha' a jelanil ak'b'il yuj a Diosal, ak'och heb' juez yet' heb' yajal. Ha heb' ol b'o'an tas snib'ej heb' anima kajan t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u t'a ha' Éufrates chi'. Ha heb' tz'och yopisio chi', yowalil yojtak sk'ayb'ub'al a Diosal chi' heb', haxo heb' manh ojtannakok jun, tza k'ayb'ej heb'.

Haxo mach max k'anab'ajan scheknab'il a Diosal chi' yet' in cheknab'il a in rey in tik, elanhchamel tz'ak'ji'och chamel t'a yib'anh, mato tz'ik'chajel t'a yol chonhab' chi', ma tz'ik'chajek' tastak ay t'ay, ma tz'ochkan t'a preso, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winhaj Esdras icha tik: Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham, yujto ha' ix ak'an sna' winh rey chi' to niwan yelk'och skajnub' t'a Jerusalén.

Yuj swach'k'olal Jehová, wach' in t'a yichanh winh rey chi' yet' t'a heb' tz'ak'an srazón winh yet' t'a sat masanil heb' niwak yajal ayoch yet' winh. Yuj skolwal Jehová ix in tek'b'ej in b'a in molb'an masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' wetisraelal, yik smeltzaj heb' wet'ok, xchi winhaj Esdras chi'.
